
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/teamers/p/19164041" title="发布于 2025-10-24 23:21">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">DeepSeek-OCR 本地部署实践（适合新手、windows环境）</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<div class="lake-content">
<p id="u6d5b08a9" class="ne-p" style="text-align: center"><span class="ne-text" style="font-size: 18px">上效果：</span></p>
<p class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text" style="font-size: 18px"><img alt="image" width="702" height="264" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/393242/202510/393242-20251024181430901-136770935.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<div class="lake-content"><span style="font-size: 18px"><img alt="image" width="430" height="526" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/393242/202510/393242-20251024181504945-1253699167.png" class="lazyload"></span></div>
<p id="u44ffdbb7" class="ne-p"><span style="font-size: 18px"><strong><span class="ne-text">结论：</span></strong><span class="ne-text"><strong>windows官方示例仅可转换图片，linux下官方示例可转图片和PDF文件</strong>。</span></span></p>
<p class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text" style="font-size: 18px">原因是转换PDF的代码用到了vllm，vllm仅可在linux系统下部署使用。（仅官方示例，如果自己编写代码进行PDF转图片，并处理多张图片的上下文语义，那么就没差别了）</span></p>
<p id="ubb4640c9" class="ne-p"><span style="font-size: 18px"><span class="ne-text">deepseek-ocr 官方库提供了 </span><span class="ne-text">transformers和vllm两种推理解析方式，transformers仅提供了图片识别的示例，vllm提供了图片识别和pdf识别两种示例。vllm仅可在linux系统下部署使用。</span></span></p>
<p id="u0e9f1ff2" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text" style="font-size: 18px">如果只需要图片识别，windows和linux两种系统都可以。如果需要pdf识别，则需要使用linux系统部署。</span></p>
<p id="udb94f28a" class="ne-p"><span style="font-size: 18px"><strong><span class="ne-text">我的电脑环境:</span></strong></span></p>
<p id="uff23b560" class="ne-p"><span style="font-size: 18px"><strong><span class="ne-text">windows 11、显卡 5060</span></strong></span></p>
<p id="ua27f65b1" class="ne-p"><span style="font-size: 18px"><span class="ne-text">deepseek-ocr官方代码库：</span><a class="ne-link" href="https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-OCR" rel="noopener nofollow" target="_blank" data-href="https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-OCR"><span class="ne-text">https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-OCR</span></a></span></p>
<p id="u573f5196" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text" style="font-size: 18px">需要安装的内容：</span></p>
<p id="u874092fc" class="ne-p"><span style="font-size: 18px"><span class="ne-text">git、python、</span><span class="ne-text">Anaconda、cuda、pytorch(torch、torchvision、torchaudio、numpy)</span></span></p>
<p id="ube00579b" class="ne-p"><span style="font-size: 18px"><strong><span class="ne-text">我电脑使用的版本如下</span></strong></span></p>
<p id="ud247fd6e" class="ne-p"><span style="font-size: 18px"><img alt="image" width="690" height="255" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/393242/202510/393242-20251024181930558-1992660724.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p id="ueb890b77" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text" style="font-size: 18px">环境安装中因为CUDA版本不匹配，模型识别不了，反复切换过几次cuda、troch、flash_attn的版本。</span></p>
<p id="ue550e6f7" class="ne-p"><span style="font-size: 18px"><strong><span class="ne-text">这些软件的版本需要根据个人电脑显卡型号确定</span></strong><span class="ne-text">，一定要根据自己的电脑配置情况下载匹配版本，下边会详细介绍。</span></span></p>
<p id="u2c36172e" class="ne-p"><span style="font-size: 18px">&nbsp;</span></p>
<p id="u95ecbd05" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text" style="font-size: 18px">安装部署过程</span></p>
<p id="u6834f971" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text" style="font-size: 18px"><strong>1、安装git：</strong></span></p>
<p class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text" style="font-size: 18px">为了拉取deepseek-ocr的项目代码（如果电脑已经安装跳过，安装系统可以使用的版本即可）</span></p>
<p id="ub499b15a" class="ne-p"><span style="font-size: 18px"><a class="ne-link" href="https://git-scm.com/install/windows" rel="noopener nofollow" target="_blank" data-href="https://git-scm.com/install/windows"><span class="ne-text">https://git-scm.com/install/windows</span></a></span></p>
<p id="u92becfd4" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text" style="font-size: 18px">从官网下载对应电脑程序，一步步安装即可。</span></p>
<p id="udb1d5ab0" class="ne-p"><span style="font-size: 18px"><strong><span class="ne-text">2.获取deepseek-ocr 代码仓库</span></strong></span></p>
<p class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text" style="font-size: 18px">从电脑上想安装deepseek-ocr的文件夹下输入cmd</span></p>
<p id="ue5f09bd0" class="ne-p"><span style="font-size: 18px"><img alt="image" width="696" height="86" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/393242/202510/393242-20251024181943893-208467833.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p id="ueefbfbb1" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text" style="font-size: 18px">在打开的命令窗口中，输入 git clone https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-OCR.git</span></p>
<p id="udaea5719" class="ne-p"><span style="font-size: 18px"><strong><span class="ne-text">3.安装python 3.12.9</span></strong></span></p>
<p id="u0c6b42d3" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text" style="font-size: 18px"><strong> deepseek-ocr 推荐的python版本是3.12.9</strong>，建议安装此版本 </span></p>
<p id="uadfbe620" class="ne-p"><span style="font-size: 18px"><a class="ne-link" href="https://www.python.org/downloads/windows/" rel="noopener nofollow" target="_blank" data-href="https://www.python.org/downloads/windows/"><span class="ne-text">https://www.python.org/downloads/windows/</span></a></span></p>
<p id="uf25e247f" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text" style="font-size: 18px">下载自己电脑适合的版本</span></p>
<p id="u12166aa0" class="ne-p"><span style="font-size: 18px"><img alt="image" width="688" height="286" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/393242/202510/393242-20251024181958117-287364684.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p id="ueef3841b" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text" style="font-size: 18px">注意：<strong>下边两个复选框要勾上再点 </strong>安装或 install ，之后一步步安装即可。</span></p>
<div class="lake-content"><span style="font-size: 18px"><img alt="image" width="529" height="382" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/393242/202510/393242-20251024182025496-361434037.png" class="lazyload"></span></div>
<p id="u58b5c75f" class="ne-p"><span style="font-size: 18px"><span class="ne-text">不会安装的可以 参考：</span><a class="ne-link" href="https://blog.csdn.net/biancheng_syz/article/details/139995035" rel="noopener nofollow" target="_blank" data-href="https://blog.csdn.net/biancheng_syz/article/details/139995035"><span class="ne-text">https://blog.csdn.net/biancheng_syz/article/details/139995035</span></a></span></p>
<p id="u29c21df5" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text" style="font-size: 18px">安装完成后在命令框中 输入 python --version,返回如下结果即可。</span></p>
<p id="u41a5b491" class="ne-p"><span style="font-size: 18px"><img alt="image" width="703" height="271" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/393242/202510/393242-20251024182042994-1278483948.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p id="u3b541e32" class="ne-p"><span style="font-size: 18px"><strong><span class="ne-text">4.安装 Anaconda</span></strong></span></p>
<p id="ua3a24c78" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text" style="font-size: 18px">可以从官网或镜像网站中下载</span></p>
<p id="ub733526e" class="ne-p"><span style="font-size: 18px"><span class="ne-text">官网：</span><a class="ne-link" href="https://www.anaconda.com/download" rel="noopener nofollow" target="_blank" data-href="https://www.anaconda.com/download"><span class="ne-text">https://www.anaconda.com/download</span></a></span></p>
<p id="uec931d93" class="ne-p"><span style="font-size: 18px"><span class="ne-text">镜像地址：</span><a class="ne-link" href="https://repo.anaconda.com/archive/" rel="noopener nofollow" target="_blank" data-href="https://repo.anaconda.com/archive/"><span class="ne-text">https://repo.anaconda.com/archive/</span></a></span></p>
<p id="udaf5bc4d" class="ne-p"><span style="font-size: 18px"><img alt="image" width="696" height="206" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/393242/202510/393242-20251024182055554-974246927.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p id="u83f3acb4" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text" style="font-size: 18px">一步步安装即可，此处记得勾选下</span></p>
<p id="u64e55c33" class="ne-p"><span style="font-size: 18px"><img alt="image" width="692" height="561" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/393242/202510/393242-20251024182103339-779559137.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p id="u42ccaab1" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text" style="font-size: 18px">安装完成后在环境变量中增加配置</span></p>
<p id="u48317bf4" class="ne-p"><span style="font-size: 18px"><img alt="image" width="740" height="476" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/393242/202510/393242-20251024182111545-2002496829.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="ne-p"><span style="font-size: 18px"><img alt="image" width="744" height="751" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/393242/202510/393242-20251024182118870-346433766.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="ne-p"><span style="font-size: 18px"><img alt="image" width="741" height="734" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/393242/202510/393242-20251024182124901-744788216.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="ne-p"><span style="font-size: 18px"><img alt="image" width="742" height="720" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/393242/202510/393242-20251024182131607-860936121.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p id="u565e549d" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text" style="font-size: 18px">&nbsp;</span></p>
<p id="u1fba49cb" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text" style="font-size: 18px">增加以上4项内容，D:\softInstall\Anaconda是我的安装目录，需要换成你自己的安装目录，配置完成后cmd 输入conda --version，返回如下信息即安装成功</span></p>
<p id="u4109a977" class="ne-p"><span style="font-size: 18px"><img alt="image" width="738" height="298" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/393242/202510/393242-20251024182143077-1243914608.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p id="u310f37df" class="ne-p"><span style="font-size: 18px"><span class="ne-text">5.安装CUDA （</span><span style="color: rgba(224, 62, 45, 1)"><strong><span class="ne-text">一定要注意版本、一定要注意版本</span></strong></span><span class="ne-text">）</span></span></p>
<p id="u642ea616" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text" style="font-size: 18px">deepseek推荐使用11.8，<strong>不用必须11.8</strong>，之上即可。</span></p>
<p id="uf3e72c0f" class="ne-p"><span style="font-size: 18px"><img alt="image" width="728" height="32" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/393242/202510/393242-20251024182148716-879122288.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p id="u77ef3358" class="ne-p"><span style="font-size: 18px"><strong><span class="ne-text">安装之前 cmd 进入命令行，检查驱动和cuda支持版本</span></strong></span></p>
<p id="u72359746" class="ne-p"><span style="font-size: 18px"><img alt="image" width="741" height="397" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/393242/202510/393242-20251024182154072-200294235.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p id="ua57d6640" class="ne-p"><span style="font-size: 18px"><span class="ne-text">我的是12.8，进入cuda官网下载</span><a class="ne-link" href="https://developer.nvidia.com/cuda-toolkit-archive" rel="noopener nofollow" target="_blank" data-href="https://developer.nvidia.com/cuda-toolkit-archive"><span class="ne-text">https://developer.nvidia.com/cuda-toolkit-archive</span></a></span></p>
<p id="ua75bd140" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text" style="font-size: 18px">根据自己电脑型号选好</span></p>
<p id="ucdd4b870" class="ne-p"><span style="font-size: 18px"><img alt="image" width="739" height="520" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/393242/202510/393242-20251024182200479-1281265509.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p id="ue2370c79" class="ne-p"><span style="font-size: 18px"><img alt="image" width="749" height="388" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/393242/202510/393242-20251024182208991-684948217.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p id="ubabd2d79" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text" style="font-size: 18px">选择对应版本下载后，一路下一步安装即可，安装完成后，cmd, 输入 nvcc -V，返回版本信息即可</span></p>
<p id="u7d4064cc" class="ne-p"><span style="font-size: 18px"><img alt="image" width="725" height="153" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/393242/202510/393242-20251024182215765-692659170.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p id="ud4ddd466" class="ne-p"><span style="font-size: 18px"><span class="ne-text">6.安装PyTorch（</span><strong><span class="ne-text"><span style="color: rgba(224, 62, 45, 1)">一定要注意版本、一定要注意版本</span>）</span></strong></span></p>
<p id="u22443ff0" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text" style="font-size: 18px"><strong>deepseek-ocr自己环境使用的 2.6.0</strong>,我这使用的 2.7.0，<strong>因为适配cuda12.8版本的最低的 pytorch就是2.7.0</strong></span></p>
<p id="u7db0287b" class="ne-p"><span style="font-size: 18px"><strong><span class="ne-text">pytorch版本需要需要根据前边安装的cuda和python的版本进行安装</span></strong><span class="ne-text">，</span><span style="color: rgba(224, 62, 45, 1)"><strong><span class="ne-text">匹配规则解释</span></strong></span><span class="ne-text">：</span></span></p>
<p id="u443ee6e4" class="ne-p"><span style="font-size: 18px"><strong><span class="ne-text">cu128 代表 cuda版本是12.8，cp312 代表 python版本 3.12.X win就是windows；</span></strong></span></p>
<p id="u0bcd3a73" class="ne-p"><span style="font-size: 18px"><img alt="image" width="737" height="144" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/393242/202510/393242-20251024182239941-721150169.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p id="u31a5b40d" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text" style="font-size: 18px">pytorch 可以使用命令下载安装，也可以下载文件后本地安装，我使用的下载后本地安装</span></p>
<p id="u5ad2381d" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text" style="font-size: 18px">下载地址 </span></p>
<p id="uf9b4d944" class="ne-p"><span style="font-size: 18px"><a class="ne-link" href="https://download.pytorch.org/whl/nightly/cu128" rel="noopener nofollow" target="_blank" data-href="https://download.pytorch.org/whl/nightly/cu128"><span class="ne-text">https://download.pytorch.org/whl/nightly/cu128</span></a><span class="ne-text"> 其中128为显卡版本号</span></span></p>
<p id="uf2a01e0d" class="ne-p"><span style="font-size: 18px"><img alt="image" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/393242/202510/393242-20251024182246045-2052849998.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p id="ua73b47a9" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text" style="font-size: 18px">进入对应文件目录，按照上边说的匹配规则查找对应文件下载到本机。</span></p>
<p id="u45a22d17" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text" style="font-size: 18px">进入下载完成的文件夹目录，在目录中输入cmd,</span></p>
<p id="u8ecd72a0" class="ne-p"><span style="font-size: 18px"><img alt="image" width="737" height="346" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/393242/202510/393242-20251024182334096-1880025159.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p id="ueda62edd" class="ne-p"><span style="font-size: 18px">&nbsp;</span></p>
<p id="u470a8cdd" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text" style="font-size: 18px">打开命令行后依次输入命令安装<strong>,install 后为下载的文件名</strong> <strong>注意改成自己的</strong></span></p>
<p id="ue11bf8cd" class="ne-p"><span style="font-size: 18px"><strong><span class="ne-text">pip install torch-2.7.0+cu128-cp312-cp312-win_amd64.whl</span></strong></span></p>
<p id="uaff92a44" class="ne-p"><span style="font-size: 18px"><strong><span class="ne-text">pip install torchaudio-2.7.0+cu128-cp312-cp312-win_amd64.whl</span></strong></span></p>
<p id="u844e19df" class="ne-p"><span style="font-size: 18px"><strong><span class="ne-text">pip install torchvision-0.22.0+cu128-cp312-cp312-win_amd64.whl</span></strong></span></p>
<p id="uc0bec4aa" class="ne-p"><span style="font-size: 18px"><strong><span class="ne-text">pip install numpy-2.3.3-cp312-cp312-win_amd64.whl</span></strong></span></p>
<p id="u2309a19d" class="ne-p"><span style="font-size: 18px">&nbsp;</span></p>
<p id="u350c2464" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text" style="font-size: 18px">7.创建deepseek-ocr项目并激活</span></p>
<p id="ufbec37cc" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text" style="font-size: 18px">进入第一步拉取的deepseek-ocr项目目录下 输入cmd,打开命令窗口</span></p>
<p id="u8f724869" class="ne-p"><span style="font-size: 18px"><img alt="image" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/393242/202510/393242-20251024182345247-2091317220.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p id="u66086a32" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text" style="font-size: 18px">conda create -n deepseek-ocr python=3.12.9 -y</span></p>
<p id="ud32f77fc" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text" style="font-size: 18px">conda activate deepseek-ocr</span></p>
<p id="u2a44aa44" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text" style="font-size: 18px">执行成功效果如下</span></p>
<p id="u75632579" class="ne-p"><span style="font-size: 18px"><img alt="image" width="734" height="274" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/393242/202510/393242-20251024182353406-1106124131.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p id="u996cb523" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text" style="font-size: 18px">如果第一次执行activate，需要先执行下 conda init 后再执行 conda activate deepseek-ocr 即可。</span></p>
<p id="ueb37e2fc" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text" style="font-size: 18px">8、安装依赖文件</span></p>
<p id="u32ed35c1" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text" style="font-size: 18px">继续在上边项目命令窗口中执行 <strong>pip install-r requirements.txt </strong>，安装项目依赖的一些文件</span></p>
<p id="u86a16657" class="ne-p"><span style="font-size: 18px"><span class="ne-text">9.安装</span><strong><span class="ne-text">flash-attn</span></strong></span></p>
<p id="ub75b547d" class="ne-p"><span style="color: rgba(224, 62, 45, 1); font-size: 18px"><strong><span class="ne-text">此文件也要注意版本，很多人安装不上就是卡在这一步了。</span></strong></span></p>
<p id="u94c65a76" class="ne-p"><span style="font-size: 18px"><span class="ne-text">问题1：</span><strong><span class="ne-text">在线安装成功率低</span></strong></span></p>
<p class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text" style="font-size: 18px">在线安装可以使用类似命令：pip install flash-attn==2.7.4 --no-build-isolation</span></p>
<p id="u3bd736f0" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text" style="font-size: 18px">我采用的方式是下载到本地再安装。</span></p>
<p id="u3b8ac202" class="ne-p"><span style="font-size: 18px"><strong><span class="ne-text">官网推荐使用的2.7.3跟我的cuda12.8，PyTorch 2.7.0不匹配，所以按照规则，去下载使用自己的版本</span></strong></span></p>
<p id="u9e76f536" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text" style="font-size: 18px">此处window环境下编译的版本不好找，废了半天劲找到了这个宝藏地址，注意cu、torch、cp版本号，分别需要与cuda、PyTorch、python的版本保持一致</span></p>
<p id="u27a69d29" class="ne-p"><span style="font-size: 18px"><a class="ne-link" href="https://github.com/kingbri1/flash-attention/releases" rel="noopener nofollow" target="_blank" data-href="https://github.com/kingbri1/flash-attention/releases"><span class="ne-text">https://github.com/kingbri1/flash-attention/releases</span></a></span></p>
<p id="ue77e0128" class="ne-p"><span style="font-size: 18px"><img alt="image" width="730" height="538" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/393242/202510/393242-20251024182401637-233779219.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p id="u7bc9b581" class="ne-p"><span style="font-size: 18px"><strong><span class="ne-text">问题2：文件下载到本地时 名称中的+号会丢失变为空白 需修改下文件名补充上</span></strong></span></p>
<p id="u8b7e4546" class="ne-p"><span style="font-size: 18px"><img alt="image" width="728" height="52" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/393242/202510/393242-20251024182408994-1317219503.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p id="u6d4bdd50" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text" style="font-size: 18px">下载完成后，在对应目录cmd打开命令窗口安装flash_attn，执行 </span></p>
<p id="u1495d168" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text" style="font-size: 18px">pip install flash_attn-2.7.4.post1+cu128torch2.7.0cxx11abiFALSE-cp312-cp312-win_amd64.whl</span></p>
<p id="uc0b05f39" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text" style="font-size: 18px">提示success 的一段提示即代表安装成功</span></p>
<p id="uea896050" class="ne-p"><span style="font-size: 18px"><strong><span class="ne-text">10.下载模型文件到本地</span></strong></span></p>
<p id="ua87b3f8e" class="ne-p"><span style="font-size: 18px"><span class="ne-text">ModelScope下载地址：</span><a class="ne-link" href="https://modelscope.cn/models/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-OCR/summary" rel="noopener nofollow" target="_blank" data-href="https://modelscope.cn/models/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-OCR/summary"><span class="ne-text">https://modelscope.cn/models/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-OCR/summary</span></a></span></p>
<p id="u943e6333" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text" style="font-size: 18px">按照提示下载模型到本地即可</span></p>
<p id="ue6e160d2" class="ne-p"><span style="font-size: 18px"><img alt="image" width="734" height="377" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/393242/202510/393242-20251024182414844-602112257.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p id="u98b58567" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text" style="font-size: 18px"><br><strong>11、更改deepseek-ocr中模型文件目录，和要解析的输入输出文件目录</strong></span></p>
<p id="u8801b551" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text" style="font-size: 18px">这就是开头提到的windows局限的地方，</span></p>
<p id="u495fabde" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text" style="font-size: 18px">linux下边 可以在安装上vllm模型，按照这种方式 对pdf进行识别解析。</span></p>
<p id="u0a887af3" class="ne-p"><span style="font-size: 18px"><a class="ne-link" href="https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/releases/tag/v0.8.5" rel="noopener nofollow" target="_blank" data-href="https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/releases/tag/v0.8.5"><span class="ne-text">https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/releases/tag/v0.8.5</span></a></span></p>
<p id="uc52a4c9c" class="ne-p"><span style="font-size: 18px"><img alt="image" width="739" height="211" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/393242/202510/393242-20251024182424476-672151260.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p id="u73aec3e8" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text" style="font-size: 18px">windows下暂不支持，如多直接使用官方示例在DeepSeek-OCR-hf下仅可对图片进行识别，未提供直接可用的PDF识别示意代码。可以自己写代码处理PDF转换（后续上示例）。</span></p>
<p id="ub9189843" class="ne-p"><span style="font-size: 18px"><img alt="image" width="737" height="105" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/393242/202510/393242-20251024182430435-1080082263.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p id="u59e1b6eb" class="ne-p"><span style="font-size: 18px"><img alt="image" width="740" height="357" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/393242/202510/393242-20251024182436137-808572662.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p id="u14250de4" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text" style="font-size: 18px">12.上才艺</span></p>
<p id="u236e57b9" class="ne-p"><span style="font-size: 18px"><img alt="image" width="737" height="973" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/393242/202510/393242-20251024182443695-217661503.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p class="ne-p"><span style="font-size: 18px"><img alt="image" width="740" height="278" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/393242/202510/393242-20251024181430901-136770935.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p id="u382e827d" class="ne-p"><span style="font-size: 18px">&nbsp;</span></p>
<p id="u2d1ebf0d" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text" style="font-size: 18px">输入目录种的文档：</span></p>
<p class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text" style="font-size: 18px"><img alt="image" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/393242/202510/393242-20251024182519020-949055447.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p id="u35cd5b32" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text" style="font-size: 18px">一个解析识别后的图片示意、一个markdown的文件，一个图片文件夹</span></p>
<p id="u78ed7559" class="ne-p"><span style="font-size: 18px">&nbsp;</span></p>
<p id="ub21dd74b" class="ne-p"><span style="font-size: 18px"><img alt="image" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/393242/202510/393242-20251024181504945-1253699167.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p id="uf0670863" class="ne-p"><span style="font-size: 18px"><img alt="image" width="736" height="550" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/393242/202510/393242-20251024182530448-2088819154.png" class="lazyload"></span></p>
<p id="uf50d8ba0" class="ne-p"><span class="ne-text" style="font-size: 18px">效果还是挺好的，识别速度、准确率都不错。后边做分析和项目实战再做分享。</span></p>
<p id="uc67fdd8f" class="ne-p"><span style="font-size: 18px">&nbsp;</span></p>
